rules.title: Hide the license agreement screen
rules.summary: The license is accepted in Setup (AcceptEula), so the screen is not shown in OOBE.
rules.effect: One screen fewer; the organization is responsible for accepting the terms.

rules.title: Hide the manufacturer registration screen
rules.summary: The OEM registration screen is not shown (it appears only on manufacturer images).
rules.effect: Harmless on Microsoft images; saves a screen on OEM images.

rules.title: Hide the Microsoft account screens
rules.summary: The screens for signing in with a Microsoft account are not shown (Windows shows them only with an internet connection). The local account screen is skipped because the accounts are defined in the file.
rules.effect: After setup, the system goes straight to the sign-in screen with the initial accounts. With "Ask for the account during installation" in the "Accounts" form, Windows shows only its local account screen.
rules.risk: Without it, Windows 11 Pro asks for a Microsoft account when the PC is online, also when the account is asked during installation.

rules.title: Hide the network connection screen
rules.summary: The "Let's connect you to a network" screen is always hidden, not only on a wired connection.
rules.effect: Setup does not stop on laptops without a network cable; Wi-Fi is configured after sign-in.

rules.title: Privacy settings screen: turn off express settings
rules.summary: The privacy screen is not shown; diagnostic data sending, advertising and location are turned off by default.
rules.effect: SmartScreen and Defender are not affected: they are enabled by separate rules.
rules.versions: Value 3 works on Windows 10 and 11, including 24H2.
